summary: Completed patch compatibility analysis and directed testing for haproxy commit 98b1fd4ff9a719f34131fa04cbd93f92c0c362f7 ("BUG/MEDIUM: h3: Properly handle PUSH_PROMISE on backend connections"). Found 1 compatibility change (ERROR_EXCEPTION_CHANGE, PCA-0001) where the old code incorrectly treated H3_ERR_ID_ERROR (a positive value 0x108) as consumed bytes causing buffer corruption. The fix properly calls qcc_set_error() and jumps to error handler. Build and contract verification (version, features, mux, config parsing) passed with identical before/after behavior. H3 PUSH_PROMISE protocol path could not be exercised without vtest/varnishtest. All worktrees cleaned up.
